title: API, MCP or MCP App? Choosing the right surface for AI agents

runs in every single platform out there. Second is tool descriptions are more than just the documentation. So tool descriptions uh for MCPS are the way
that the LLM can discover what kind of tools that it can use, how to use them and actually when to use them. It also
explains what kind of inputs the tool might need and how what what outputs uh can be expected by the LLM to get from it. So it kind of navigates the LLM to
understand which kind of tools that it can use. So in case you have tool two tools which have very similar descriptions, your LLM might not be that
good at deciding which one to use and maybe you don't need two tools and it could already fit in one. So having something uh around uh tool descriptions
is very important and that's where uh we see that small changes in the tool descriptions cause big changes on how the LLM behaves in using those tools and
that's why it's really important on having really good evaluations on how this tool invocation and selectability is with the LLM. >> Thank you. Next up, the third takeaway
